parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Considering the advantages and at least one disadvantage, explain why Jini might choose
the University of Zandi course.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain two disadvantages of the Zandi City Council Masterclasses with Oli Pomerini.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two disadvantages of the Carla Patel course.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Which one piece of the additional information provided might Jini have regarded as the least
relevant in deciding which course to take?
Justify your choice.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
The term ‘social media influencers’ describes key individuals in, for example, entertainment
or fashion, whose online blogs or photographs have become increasingly important for marketing
departments.
In your opinion, state why these key individuals are so influential.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
The term ‘early adopter’ refers to a person who starts using technology or products as soon
as they become available.
Give three reasons which you think might motivate someone to be an early adopter.
Section B
Read the material for Section B in the insert before answering the questions in Section B.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
According to Gràcia, state what motivates him to spend ‘most weekends exploring and mapping
the island’s complex system of underwater caves’.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: describe five things that went wrong as Gràcia and Mascaró headed for home.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: explain what their options were and why they were dangerous.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: identify what Gràcia did to ensure he would survive for as long as possible.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: describe what side effects of breathing high levels of carbon dioxide he experienced.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: State three of the problems that delayed the rescue of Gràcia.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Suggest why you think that Gràcia’s children ‘don’t tell’ him ‘not to do it’. (line 62)
